package composeconfig

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// GetComposeConfig fetches compose config by id with tech ids.
type GetComposeConfig struct {
	ComposeConfigs     repository.ComposeConfigRepository
	ComposeConfigTechs repository.ComposeConfigTechRepository
}

// Handle returns config and tech ids.
func (uc GetComposeConfig) Handle(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.ComposeConfig, []int, error) {
	cfg, err := uc.ComposeConfigs.GetByID(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	var techIDs []int
	if uc.ComposeConfigTechs != nil {
		techIDs, err = uc.ComposeConfigTechs.ListTechIDs(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, err
		}
	}
	return cfg, techIDs, nil
}
